name: Ocean BPool single-sided join-exit math drain
summary: Ocean BPool joinswapExternAmountIn prices pool-share minting from a base-token-only deposit while SideStaking mirrors the leg with datatokens and matching shares, and exitswapPoolAmountIn redeems through calcSingleOutGivenPoolIn so the same shares buy back more base token than the join paid for. The attacker flash-swapped mOCEAN and cycled single-sided joins and exits across eight SideStaking-managed clones, extracting a net 127,861.01 mOCEAN after repaying the flash swap.

loss.notes: The mOCEAN quantity is the exact onchain exit to the attacker EOA inside the anchor; the $11.9K figure is the reported contemporaneous-pricing estimate over a memecoin-paired token. Flash-swapped principal was repaid in-transaction and only the net extraction is counted.

ageReset.description: The pool is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the BPool logic 0xbb3051df2d3e408dae6e6daa2296bc6215f0dcfd and cannot be repointed. The clone creation is therefore the change that put that code into service for this execution context.

sources.note: Anchor 0x6dc8a7fba1303faef3ec7afa770b90b17ec5ecd73b51229277a9b0492e285796 at Polygon block 89107757 index 23 runs 65 joinswapExternAmountIn and 40 exitswapPoolAmountIn calls across eight BPool clones with mirrored SideStaking Stake and UnStake calls, flash-swapping 1,261.59 mOCEAN in, repaying 1,265.39 and exiting a net 127,861.01 mOCEAN to 0x3fa8cf7fea68c8e76a9838d77889464ddfb6a6cf. Root cause is the non-inverse single-sided join and exit math once SideStaking participates: joins mint shares for both attacker and controller against only the attacker's base token, exits redeem the same shares for more base token. The representative target 0x95f57249e6dd394318025068a8bfc841ac6ec0dd drew the largest share of the drain and stands for all eight drained clones of the same logic under the sibling rule. It is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy hardcoding logic 0xbb3051df2d3e408dae6e6daa2296bc6215f0dcfd, created internally by 0x78e1317186786591912a10a7af2490b8b4697a93 inside 0xb8da02cf5202c746c9682fc6df75c92985a1fae3a70de290c6b0971637e3d1c4 at block 29349611 index 75; its runtime is byte-identical at deployment and pre-exploit and cannot be repointed, so deployment is the latest code change and age 127,601,979 seconds. Neither the factory nor the deployer is an attacker address. Loss is the exact onchain mOCEAN exit valued at the reported contemporaneous $11.9K.

limitations: The $11.9K headline is a reported contemporaneous-pricing estimate over a memecoin-paired token; the structured mOCEAN quantity is exact onchain.
